title: The newcomer three months in: the price from the price list, one time, the booking; a doubt stepped over
purpose: People, slot 7, the afternoon of the day the timing-belt customer argued at his counter. He will not say a price or a time he has not looked up. He takes a name, offers a time, books and repeats it. He still asks nothing about the car and still answers 'that's more than I was hoping' with 'yes ma'am'.

call.day: slot 7's 3rd working day before T (rule R6; people, call 14)

scenario.who_calls: A first-time caller, Kayla Thornton, who has been told by a friend that her rear brakes are gone.
scenario.what_happens: Caleb reads the price off the price list, steps over 'that's more than I was hoping', offers Thursday at eight, takes her name, books, declines to guess how long the job takes, and repeats the time.

facts.note: catalogue.json rear_pads_rotors, class car, standard parts: 470.27. The price is right and read to the cent.

script.said: Brennan Auto Care, this is Caleb.
Hi. I need a price on rear brakes. Pads and rotors. It's a twenty-seventeen Nissan Rogue.
Yes ma'am. Seventeen Rogue, rear pads and rotors. Give me one second — I wanna pull it off the price list so I tell you right.
Okay. That's four seventy, twenty-seven, before tax.
Four seventy. Hm. That's more than I was hopin'.
Yes ma'am. Uh — I could get you in Thursday morning, at eight?
Thursday... I mean, yeah. I could do Thursday.
Okay. Can I get your name?
Kayla Thornton. Got it. So I've got you down for Thursday at eight, and I'll be the one checking you in. Just ask for Caleb.
How long will y'all need it?
Uh — let me not guess. I'll ask the tech in the morning and tell you for sure when you drop it off.
Thank you! Have a good one.
